description: Season-long and tournament markets (futures/outrights) such as league winner, top scorer, relegation, top-four finish or cup winner, with the likeliest outcomes and their implied probabilities. Filter by league and by words in the market title. Use for questions like "who is favourite to win the Premier League?" or "Champions League winner odds".

league.description: A league or cup: its id from list_leagues (e.g. "premier-league"), its name ("La Liga") or a common short name ("EPL", "UCL", "MLS").

outcomes_per_market.description: Likeliest outcomes to show per market (1 to 10). get_market lists more.

query.description: Words in the market title, e.g. "winner", "top scorer", "relegated".

name: list_futures

closes.description: When the market settles at the latest, ISO 8601 UTC.

traded_30d_usd.description: US dollars traded in the last 30 days.

note.description: Why the list is empty or cut short.

title: List futures markets
